attributes.name: Min
attributes.helptext: The minimum number that can be output.

attributes.name: Max
attributes.helptext: The maximum number that can be output.

attributes.name: DurationMode
attributes.helptext: If set to Every Update, a new random number will be generated every network update. If set to Specify, a random number will be generated every specified number of seconds.

attributes.name: Interval
attributes.helptext: The number of seconds to wait before generating a new random number.

attributes.name: Seed
attributes.helptext: Used to initialize the random number generator.

attributes.name: GenerateSeed
attributes.helptext: If set to Generated, the runtime target will generate a seed instead of using the specified seed.

helptext: Node used to generate a random number in a specified range, that changes over time
